proposal.summary: The report states an improper neutralization of special elements used in a command (command injection) vulnerability exists in Liman Central Management System Liman MYS affecting HTTP/Controllers, CronMail, Jobs modules.
proposal.affected_product: Liman Central Management System Liman MYS: from 1.7.0 before 1.8.3-462
